name: Reef (Reef Perfumes)
verdict: Reef Perfumes is controlled by Saudi brothers Abdulaziz, Faisal and Fahad Bader Al Majed (25-50% each per UK Companies House filings). No state owner. Nothing found.
note: Saudi fragrance brand (reefperfumes.com). Centre-chest mark on Al-Hilal's 2026/27 home shirt (club's official store photos and league kit gallery); 'official partner' on the club's partners page.
